gaps.quote: the node's outside work is $O(VK^{\tau})$ for its chunk exchanges
gaps.note: The page gives outside work O(VK^tau), which divided by V is O(K^tau), but the recurrence uses (mfK)^tau. The page never says why K becomes mfK.
Intermediate moduli up to 2^(d/2) and denominators gaining D binary digits give widths of p plus O(d). The page never relates d to p, so O(p) widths are not shown.
